summary: Selects a color buffer or related render output from Render TOP, GLSL TOP, or CPlusPlus TOP sources, including camera index, peel layer index, and image output selection.

key_params.name: top
key_params.note: Render TOP, GLSL TOP, or CPlusPlus TOP source.

key_params.name: cameraindex
key_params.note: Camera output index when source renders multiple cameras.

key_params.name: imageoutput
key_params.note: Select image output enabled on the source Render TOP GLSL page.

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Common TOP Generator output resolution behavior.

common_gotchas: The source TOP must be a compatible Render TOP, GLSL TOP, or CPlusPlus TOP.
Image Output requires the source Render TOP GLSL page to enable image output.
Color buffer index must match the number of color buffers produced by the source render.
Camera index only matters when the source Render TOP renders multiple cameras.
key_concepts: Selects a color buffer or related output from Render TOP, GLSL TOP, or CPlusPlus TOP sources.
Camera Index selects among multiple camera outputs from the source render.
Peel Layer Index selects Render TOP depth-peel layers.
Image Output only works when the source Render TOP GLSL image output is enabled.
